description: CORE TABLE. Axis Bank segment-level revenue, profit before tax, assets and liabilities, standalone and consolidated, for Q1FY27, Q4FY26, Q1FY26 and FY26. One row per entity x period x segment. All INR values in crore.
Standalone (Axis Bank only) or Consolidated (bank + subsidiaries). Use Standalone for bank customer profitability.
Reporting period. Q = quarter, FY26 = full year ended 31-Mar-2026.
Date of the segment assets/liabilities used for that period (quarter-end; FY26 uses 31-Mar-2026).
Digital Banking and Other Retail Banking are sub-segments of Retail Banking. FILTER is_subsegment = FALSE before summing, or you will double count Retail.

Gross segment revenue INCLUDING inter-segment revenue (internal funds transfer pricing). Retail earns FTP credit for the deposits/CASA it raises; this is how CASA profitability shows up. Totals reconcile to income from operations only after deducting inter-segment revenue (see 01b).
Segment result after provisions and before tax.
Segment balance sheet at balance_sheet_date. Assets are mainly loans (credit given); liabilities are mainly deposits (CASA + term).
Derived: liabilities minus assets. Positive = segment is a net provider of funds to the bank (deposit-rich, e.g. Retail); negative = net user of funds (loan-heavy, e.g. Corporate, Treasury).
Derived: PBT / segment revenue x 100. Blank for Unallocated.

Derived return on segment assets: PBT x 4 / period-end assets for quarters; PBT / Mar-26 assets for FY26. Uses period-end, not average, assets. Blank for Other Banking Business (fee-based, tiny asset base makes the ratio meaningless) and Unallocated.
Derived: liabilities / assets. Above 1 = deposit-funded surplus.
Derived: segment value / entity total for the same period. Revenue share uses gross segment revenue total (before inter-segment elimination).
Derived growth, filled only on Q1FY27 rows (vs Q1FY26 and Q4FY26).
Segment totals, inter-segment revenue elimination and capital, for reconciling 01 to the reported income statement and balance sheet.

Loans given (Corporate, SME, Retail) and deposits (Savings, Current, CASA, Term, CASA on average balance basis), Jun-2025 vs Jun-2026, INR crore. reported_yoy_growth_pct is the bank's rounded figure; yoy_growth_pct is recomputed from the amounts.
Derived share of total loans or total month-end deposits. Blank for the QAB row, which is on a different (average) basis.

Standalone P&L line items for the four periods, INR crore, plus derived lines (is_derived = TRUE): NII, operating revenue, cost-to-income, provisions/operating profit, effective tax rate. Q4FY26 tax is negative (one-time tax reversal, see source note 11), so Q4FY26 net profit is inflated.
Standalone and consolidated statement of assets and liabilities at 30-Jun-2026, 31-Mar-2026, 30-Jun-2025, INR crore.

Long-format KPIs from the press release and earnings call: margins, cost of funds, CASA growth (QAB = quarterly average balance, MEB = month-end balance), loan mix and product growth, credit cards, fees by segment, slippages by Retail/CBG/Wholesale, NPAs, capital. Filter on theme and customer_segment.
Exact PDF and page each value came from, for citation.

All component lines reconcile to reported totals within INR 0.02 crore (segment revenue, PBT, assets, liabilities, P&L arithmetic, balance sheet totals, loan and deposit splits, slippage splits). Source PDFs were scanned images; values were OCR-read and visually verified against the page images.
These are bank-level and segment-level aggregates from Axis Bank's Q1FY27 disclosures. There are NO individual customer records in the source files.
